name: Mixture Park [CHRISTMAS]
desc:
Welcome to Mixture Park!

Explore the procedurally generated houses!
Serve clients! Mix Ingredients! Hunt and plant procedurally generated plants!
Fertilize plants with infinite variety of tweaks, save your fertilized plants.
Build and Customize your base! Open worlded cooking game!
